conferenceAffiliationAudit.limitation: Conference affiliation alone does not establish individual NCAA Division I men's basketball sponsorship or NCAA championship eligibility.

definitions.participatesInDivisionOneMensBasketball: 2026-27 NCAA institution directory explicitly lists Men's Basketball, Division I.
definitions.fullDivisionOneMembership: Separate NCAA institution classification; reclassifying schools may not yet be full members.
definitions.championshipEligible: Separate NCAA postseason eligibility; do not infer from participation or conference membership.

notes: 2026-27 NCAA sport-specific directory entries are stronger evidence than conference rosters for whether a school sponsors Division I men's basketball.
